Spanish: She is learning Spanish because she wants to travel around South America next year.
她正在学习西班牙语，因为她明年想去南美洲旅行。
post office: I need to go to the post office to send this package to my grandmother.
我需要去邮局把这个包裹寄给我奶奶。
on foot: The school is not far, so the children usually go there on foot.
学校不远，所以孩子们通常步行去那里。
slow down: You should slow down when you drive near a school in the morning.
早上开车经过学校附近时你应该减速。
pay attention to: Please pay attention to the teacher when she explains the new words.
老师讲解新单词时请注意听讲。
traffic lights: Turn left when the traffic lights turn green, and you will see the bank.
交通信号灯变绿时向左转，你就会看到银行。
Munich: My cousin spent a week in Munich and enjoyed the old buildings very much.
我表哥在慕尼黑待了一周，非常喜欢那些古老的建筑。
Papa Westray: Papa Westray is a small island where planes land on one of the shortest flights in the world.
帕帕韦斯特雷岛是一个小岛，那里的航班是世界上最短的航线之一。
see a film: We plan to see a film at the new cinema near the park this weekend.
我们计划这个周末去公园附近的新电影院看一场电影。
take a trip: My family will take a trip to the seaside when the summer holiday begins.
暑假一开始，我们全家要去海边旅行。
next week: There will be an English test in our class next week, so I must review the words.
下周我们班要举行英语考试，所以我必须复习单词。
comic book: My little brother reads a comic book every night before he goes to sleep.
我弟弟每天晚上睡觉前都看一本连环画。
word book: The teacher asked us to copy the new words into our word book after class.
老师让我们课后把新单词抄到单词书上。
post card: She sent me a post card with a beautiful picture of the mountains on it.
她寄给我一张明信片，上面印着美丽的山景。
Mid-Autumn Festival: Families usually eat mooncakes and enjoy the full moon during the Mid-Autumn Festival.
中秋节期间，一家人通常吃月饼、赏圆月。
get together: Our whole family will get together at my uncle's house to celebrate the new year.
我们全家将在叔叔家聚会庆祝新年。
mooncake: This mooncake tastes sweet because it is filled with lotus seed paste.
这个月饼很甜，因为里面是莲蓉馅。
studies: His studies improved a lot after he began to review his lessons every evening.
自从他开始每晚复习功课，他的学习进步了很多。
hiking: We went hiking in the mountains last Sunday and took many photos of the forest.
上周日我们去山里远足，拍了很多森林的照片。
pen pal: I often write emails to my pen pal in Canada, and she tells me about her school life.
我经常给加拿大的笔友写邮件，她给我讲她的学校生活。
jasmine: The jasmine in our garden smells wonderful on warm summer evenings.
温暖的夏夜，我们花园里的茉莉花香极了。
Canberra: Canberra is the capital of Australia, but Sydney is a much bigger city.
堪培拉是澳大利亚的首都，但悉尼要大得多。
police officer: The police officer helped the old woman cross the busy street safely.
那位警察帮助老奶奶安全地穿过了繁忙的街道。
head teacher: Our head teacher said that the class did very well in the sports meeting.
我们校长（班主任）说我们班在运动会上表现非常出色。
see a doctor: You have had a bad cough for days, so you should see a doctor today.
你已经咳嗽好几天了，所以今天应该去看医生。
Students in our school have to wear uniforms from Monday to Friday.
我们学校的学生周一到周五必须穿校服。
take a deep breath: Before you give a speech, take a deep breath and try to relax.
演讲之前，先深呼吸，尽量放松。
count to ten: When you feel angry, count to ten slowly before you say anything.
生气的时候，先慢慢数到十再说话。
mice: The cat sat quietly by the hole, waiting for the mice to come out.
猫静静地蹲在洞口，等着老鼠出来。
stuck: The car got stuck in the mud, and we had to ask some farmers for help.
汽车陷进了泥里，我们只好向几位农民求助。
hard-working: She is a hard-working student who never hands in her homework late.
她是一个勤奋的学生，从不迟交作业。
Ms: Ms Green has taught us English for three years, and we all like her classes.
格林女士教我们英语三年了，我们都喜欢她的课。
wash my clothes: I usually wash my clothes on Saturday morning and then help Mum clean the house.
我通常周六早上洗衣服，然后帮妈妈打扫房间。
watch TV: Don't watch TV too late, or you will feel tired in class the next day.
不要看电视看到太晚，否则第二天上课会感到疲倦。
do homework: After dinner, the children do homework at the table while their parents read nearby.
晚饭后，孩子们在桌旁做作业，父母在旁边看书。
read books: My grandfather likes to read books about history in the quiet library.
我爷爷喜欢在安静的图书馆里读历史方面的书。
play football: The boys often play football on the playground after school is over.
放学后，男孩们经常在操场上踢足球。
cooking: My mother enjoys cooking, and she makes delicious noodles every Friday.
我妈妈喜欢烹饪，每周五都做美味的面条。
ice cream: It was so hot today that we bought ice cream as soon as school ended.
今天太热了，一放学我们就买了冰淇淋。
Dear: Dear Tom, thank you for inviting me to your birthday party next Saturday.
亲爱的汤姆，谢谢你邀请我参加下周六你的生日聚会。
